explication: Discordo is a terminal client for Discord. The main workflow starts in the root UI, accepts a token from the environment or a login screen, then opens chat; chat presents guild/channel navigation and message interaction. Configuration and terminal rendering support that experience, while HTTP, TLS, and gateway packages provide Discord connectivity. The README documents password, QR, and token login. Some implementation excerpts are incomplete, so uncertain internal wiring is not shown.
